name: Jeffrey De La Torre
office: Hacienda La Puente Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Jeffrey De La Torre is a member of the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Governing Board, representing Trustee Area 5. He has been an educator for over 30 years. He works as an educator for Los Angeles Unified School District.

sentences.text: Jeffrey De La Torre is a member of the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District Governing Board, representing Trustee Area 5.
He has been an educator for over 30 years.
He works as an educator for Los Angeles Unified School District.

items.text: In 2022, he said he supported ethnic studies, facility upgrades, transparency, and educational equity. He says declining enrollment impacts district resources and programs. While he was board president in 2022, the district completed a solar project. He participated in the 2022 groundbreaking for Wedgeworth Elementary School's new campus, a project approved for up to $55 million.
